description: Medtronic plc, headquartered in Galway, Ireland, is the leading global healthcare technology company, founded in 1949 and serving healthcare systems, physicians, clinicians and patients in more than 150 countries worldwide. It remains committed to a mission written by its founder in 1960 directing it to contribute to human welfare by the application of biomedical engineering in the research, design, manufacture and sale of products to alleviate pain, restore health and extend life, and it is evolving its business strategy in three key areas: accelerating innovation-driven growth, delivering value through its broad portfolio and customer relationships, and building on a strong foundation of dedication, honesty, integrity and service. Its divisions include Structural Heart & Aortic, which includes therapies to treat heart valve disorders and aortic disease such as aneurysms, dissections and transections.
